radiusSource: Radius 1.051 +/- 0.013 solar radii from Mantovan et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5398 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A.129M/abstract): 731,181 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.146 +/- 0.013 solar masses from Mantovan et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5398 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A.129M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM.
